observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 204» (L21) in the right margin; the locator is printed without the point after the number. In the line numbers 30 and 40 the 0 is printed broken. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 56: 5 stands beside the second line of the title, 10 beside L7.
body L1-L4: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type; «CAPUT LVI.» is centred, the title is set as a paragraph of three lines, the second and the third indented.
body L2-L3: the word marmore is set between a raised opening mark “ and a low closing mark „; kept as printed.
body L2: a speck stands under the line, below the ā of «rukhāmah»; it is not a sign.
body L19: a short slanting speck stands after «divisio», at the height of the tops of the letters, like a grave accent; it is not a sign.
body L24: the second s of «versus» is printed broken, like ε.
notes_right L1: the semicolon after the closing » is printed raised, at the top of the line.
notes_right L4: «al-Battānī» is printed with macrons over the a and the i; the hyphen of «mi-» is printed short and round, like a point.
body L1: a small speck stands after «CAPUT LVI.»; it is not a sign.
body L2-L4: the hyphens of «ar-rukhāmah», «mar-» and «cogno-» are of one length (3.96 pt).

notes_left L2, notes_right L4: the hyphens of «ar-Raqqah» (3.4 pt) and «al-Battānī» (3.5 pt) are a little longer than the hyphens at the ends of the lines of the notes (2.5–2.6 pt); they are kept as hyphens.
notes_left L4: the opening « before «Tabulam» is printed as one blotted angle.
notes_right L4: a speck stands at the foot of the m of «mi-»; it is not a sign.
